query: SELECT Timestamp,substring(Body,1,1800) AS body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND Timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-12 15:30:00') AND Timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-12 16:00:00') AND ResourceAttributes['host.name']='nimbus-nimbusel-1' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name']='beacon' AND (Body LIKE '%Connection to EL%' OR Body LIKE '%EL node%' OR Body LIKE '%execution client%' OR Body LIKE '%execution payload%' OR Body LIKE '%Request timed out%') AND match(Body,'^(WRN|ERR|FAT)') ORDER BY Timestamp ASC LIMIT 35
